messages.content:
You correct a list of items extracted from course or project documents, using a reviewer's issues.

Return {"changes": [...], "notes": "..."}. A change is one of:
- {"op": "add", "kind": "requirement" | "constraint" | "deliverable", "text": "<the item as one clear sentence>",
   "quote": "<the exact sentence from the document, copied character for character>", "priority", "req_type",
   "constraint_kind", "deliverable_name", "deliverable_format", "issue": <issue number>}
- {"op": "drop", "id": "R4", "issue": n}   (the item is not in the document, or is not an item at all)
- {"op": "set", "id": "R2", "field": "priority" | "req_type" | "kind" | "text", "value": "...", "issue": n}

Rules: fix only the listed issues; one change per problem. Never invent: an added item must quote a sentence that
is in the document. Do not add an item that is already listed under another wording. Setup steps that are not marked
or checked (install, clone, create an environment), background and reading instructions are not items: if an issue
asks to add one, skip it. If an issue is wrong, skip it and say so in notes. Marking criteria (E ids) are not yours
to change.

Issues:
1. [major OMISSION] at requirements: No requirements were extracted. (fix: extract the document's requirements, or check whether an item listed as a constraint or deliverable is really a requirement)

Notes from earlier attempts:
- The response omitted all extracted requirements, failing to provide any of the requested information. Identify and list each requirement explicitly, ensuring every requirement from the source is captured and clearly stated.

=== Document: marking_scheme.pdf
## Software Design Project: Marking Scheme
This document explains how the final project is marked. The project is worth 50 marks in total.
| Section | Criterion | Marks | Excellent | Adequate | Weak |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Analysis | Use-case diagram covers all actors | 6 | All actors and use cases, correct notation (6) | Most actors, minor notation errors (4) | Missing actors or wrong notation (1) |
|  | Requirements are testable | 8 | Every requirement has a measurable acceptance test (8) | Most requirements are testable (5) | Few requirements are testable (2) |
| Design | Class diagram matches the code | 10 | Diagram and code agree completely (10) | Small differences (6) | Diagram does not match the code (2) |
|  | Design patterns are justified | 6 | Each pattern is explained with a reason (6) | Patterns named but not justified (3) | No patterns or wrong use (0) |
| Implementation | Working implementation | 12 | All features work in the demo (12) | Main features work (7) | Demo fails (2) |
|  | Automated tests | 8 | Tests cover all main features and pass (8) | Some tests (4) | No tests (0) |
Total: 50 marks
## Rules
- The design document must be submitted as a single PDF file.
- The demo video must not be longer than five minutes.
- Every team member must present part of the demo.
